candidate.forecast_method: Midpoint of 90-120 K dense-grid computational range reported by Hansen et al.; literature-anchored conditional forecast, not a new EPC calculation or a statistical confidence interval.

diffraction_model.warning: Fixed common geometry to isolate H occupancy contrast; NOT relaxed H5 coordinates. PRL prose reverses metal labels: multiplicities require Mg on 8c and Ir on 4a; Mg position crosschecked against Hansen et al. No thermal, anomalous, absorption, preferred-orientation, diffuse-scattering or instrument model.

entropy_model.warning: Ideal independent octahedron orientations, exactly one vacancy each; excludes hydrogen chemical potential and other entropies, cannot predict a phase boundary.

current_experimental_checks.status: PRB accepted September 28 2026 according to publisher-deposited Crossref metadata; publisher page blocked
current_experimental_checks.result: Preprint assigns cubic H7 above ca 40 GPa, hexagonal coexistence, insulating behavior and reversion to H5 around 20 GPa during room-temperature decompression.
